name: PAO Trubnaya Metallurgicheskaya Kompaniya (TMK)
via: Listed Russian pipe producer (PAO TMK); 85.27% of shares held by MKOOO TMK Steel Holding, 14.73% free float, per tmk-group.ru share-capital page.
note: Dmitry Pumpyansky (previously ~90% beneficiary) exited TMK's beneficiary list and board in March 2022 (TMK press release 10.03.2022); the beneficiaries of TMK Steel Holding are not disclosed on the company's site.
